items.title: Process-kill recovery fixtures across outbox and provider lifecycle
acceptance: Actual process-kill fixture before outbox creation proves durable recovery without duplicate exposure.
Actual process-kill fixture before provider call proves outbox replay without duplicate submission.
Actual process-kill fixture during ambiguous transport proves reconciliation before retry.
Actual process-kill fixture after provider response but before receipt proves terminal state recovery.

items.title: Windows machine-restart persistence fixture
acceptance: Windows machine-restart persistence fixture proves execution identity, outbox, and recovery state survive reboot.
Recovery health blocks new exposure until ambiguity and settlement are cleared after restart.

items.title: Bounded recovery flatten for owned unresolved exposure
acceptance: Owned but unresolved exposure triggers bounded recovery flatten rather than silent retry or duplicate entry.
Flatten outcome is journaled with explicit ownership and ambiguity evidence.

items.title: Zero duplicate entries in real ProjectX acceptance session
acceptance: A real ProjectX acceptance session with kill, reconnect, and retry scenarios produces zero duplicate entries.
Duplicate detection is evidenced from durable intent, custom tag, and provider order identity.
items.blocked_reason: Requires real TopstepX ProjectX credentials and TS-R1-01 process-kill fixtures.

items.title: Authenticate with real TopstepX ProjectX key in shadow mode
acceptance: Gateway authenticates using a real TopstepX ProjectX key in shadow mode without submitting live risk.
Login and validate responses match observed or official contracts; parsers are not loosened to suppress errors.
items.blocked_reason: No ProjectX API subscription or credentials available in the initial scaffold.

items.title: Capture sanitized official ProjectX payload fixtures
acceptance: Sanitized fixtures captured for login, validate, account search, available contracts, open positions, and open orders.
Each SignalR user-hub and market-hub event type has at least one sanitized fixture.
Secret-like fields are recursively redacted in stored fixtures.
items.blocked_reason: Requires successful TS-R2-01 authentication against a real ProjectX session.

items.title: Reconcile account, contract, positions, and conservative PnL with TopstepX UI
acceptance: Selected account and active contract reconcile between local state and TopstepX UI.
All account positions and conservative PnL match TopstepX UI within documented tolerance.
Local hard loss-floor evidence matches authoritative dashboard or account state.
items.blocked_reason: Requires successful TS-R2-01 authentication and a configured Topstep account.

items.title: Prove user-hub and market stream subscriptions
acceptance: Every required user-hub subscription is proven with live or recorded evidence.
Quote, print, and DOM subscriptions are proven on the target machine.
Connection health fields include userHubConnected, marketHubConnected, lastUserEventAt, lastMarketEventAt, and reconciliationGeneration.
items.blocked_reason: Requires successful TS-R2-01 authentication and active market data entitlement.

items.title: Prove disconnect, reconnect, generation invalidation, and REST reconciliation
acceptance: Disconnect invalidates current entry packets and increments reconciliation generation.
Reconnect performs REST reconciliation before publishing a new executable packet.
Generation invalidation and post-reconnect state are evidenced in health and packet APIs.
items.blocked_reason: Requires proven live stream subscriptions from TS-R2-04.

items.title: Prove historical order and trade search with identity retention
acceptance: Historical order search retains custom tags and full order identity.
Historical trade search retains trade.orderId linkage to submitted entries.
items.blocked_reason: Requires successful TS-R2-01 authentication and account history.

items.title: Measure stream event rates and evidence disk growth
acceptance: Quote, print, and DOM event rates are measured on the target Windows machine.
Evidence retention policy is validated against actual disk growth under sustained streaming.
items.blocked_reason: Requires sustained live market streams from TS-R2-04.

items.title: REST envelope persistence and deterministic event-corpus replay
acceptance: Raw REST response envelopes persist where contract-drift forensics require them.
Deterministic state rebuild from the integrated provider-event journal reproduces canonical state.
Correction and contradiction semantics are defined and tested during replay.

items.title: Evidence archive, export, and disk-full acceptance
acceptance: Evidence archive and export workflow is bounded, authenticated, and redacts secrets.
Real disk-full and write-failure acceptance proves execution durability degrades safely without silent loss.

items.title: Historical sync and explicit provider bracket identification
acceptance: Historical orders and trades synchronize after offline intervals without ownership drift.
Provider-created stop and target orders are identified from an explicit relationship, not proximity inference.
Order groups and protective-leg identity persist durably.
Aggregate open-position ownership is proven without price, timing, or geometry inference.

items.title: Bracket correction, fail-closed protection, and restart reconstruction
acceptance: Tick-distance brackets correct to exact intended absolute prices.
Protection failure is visible and triggers risk reduction; armed acceptance remains disabled until proof passes.
Protection reconstructs correctly after gateway restart from durable evidence.

items.title: MOVE_STOP, MOVE_TP, and exact-leg mutation
acceptance: MOVE_STOP mutates only the intended protective leg without sibling interference.
MOVE_TP mutates only the intended protective leg without sibling interference.
Exact-leg mutation preserves unrelated working orders and sibling protection geometry.

items.title: Multi-tranche protected additions and full exit cleanup
acceptance: Independently protected additions and multiple tranches maintain per-tranche ownership.
Full exit ownership is proven and residual protective orders are cleaned up.

items.title: Canonical completed trade outcomes and learning evidence
acceptance: Canonical completed Topstep outcomes derive from provider fills with stable intent and outcome identity.
After-fee realized result, MFE, MAE, duration, exit cause, and planned versus realized risk and reward are recorded.
Account-policy effects and attribution confidence are explicit.
Incomplete or contradictory outcomes are labeled explicitly rather than inferred from balance drift.
Rejection and transport episodes are reviewable without becoming false trade outcomes.

items.title: Gateway outcome publication to glitch-topstep Hermes profile
acceptance: Gateway publishes glitch.topstep.trade_outcome.v1 to the companion Hermes profile.
Profile learning worker accepts only canonical outcomes; no balance or position-disappearance inference.

items.title: Versioned Topstep policy state machine
acceptance: Canonical product and account-stage record replaces manual environment inputs.
Provider and dashboard source provenance and hashes are recorded.
EOD balance, hard loss-floor history, and floor correction workflow are versioned locally.
Trading Combine and Express Funded lifecycle states are modeled explicitly.
Payout eligibility, pending, processed, and post-payout reconciliation are tracked.
Scaling tier and authoritative contract ceiling are sourced and reconciled.
Contradiction and stale-source handling fail visibly.

items.title: Session calendar, flat deadlines, and timezone truth
acceptance: Session flat deadlines are enforced from canonical policy state.
Holiday, early-close, timezone, and DST rules are explicit and tested.
Manual entry-window environment overrides are removed in favor of reconciled policy state.

items.title: Contract discovery, rollover, and instrument metadata
acceptance: Active Topstep contract discovery and rollover evidence are recorded.
Native tick, point value, session, and fee metadata are integrated without hard-coded assumptions.

items.title: Multi-timeframe OHLCV normalization with provenance
acceptance: Integrated 1m, 5m, 15m, and 60m OHLCV normalization is deterministic.
Gap, partial-bar, and timestamp provenance are explicit.
Session and prior-session structure features are available without a coded entry strategy.

items.title: Tape, delta, depth, and descriptive feature engine
acceptance: Trade-tape, aggressor volume, cumulative delta, depth, and liquidity evidence are normalized.
Volatility, trend, range, and location evidence are descriptive features only.
Acceptance is demonstrated on at least two Topstep-supported products.

items.title: Provider event replay and deterministic decision replay
acceptance: Raw provider events replay into canonical state and packets deterministically.
Decision and receipt replay is deterministic on identical evidence.
Simulated fills, fees, and slippage are configurable and bounded.

items.title: Comparative cognition evaluation framework
acceptance: Cognition versions are compared on identical evidence with frozen inclusion, exclusion, regime, and missing-data rules.
Reports include expectancy, drawdown, MFE/MAE capture, churn, rejection, rule survival, and uncertainty.
One sample cannot silently become hard-coded strategy policy.

items.title: Installed Hermes profile integration acceptance
acceptance: glitch-topstep-hermes-profile installs with the gateway in shadow mode using a shared local bearer token.
Profile setup confirms both jobs start paused.
/topstep_status and /trade respond with expected shadow behavior.
A five-frame flat cycle produces one strict intent and a shadow receipt.
A positioned packet permits only HOLD or EXIT each minute.
/pause_trading stops model calls and /flatten_all produces a strict risk-reducing EXIT receipt.

items.title: One-account market-readiness evidence bundle
acceptance: Actual Windows and Hermes installation acceptance is recorded.
One configured Topstep account runs with zero duplicate entries and zero unexplained unprotected exposure.
Complete reconnect, restart recovery, and attribution are evidenced.
Reconciled after-fee shadow sample and explicit operator promotion review are recorded.
First complete account and payout lifecycle evidence is captured.

items.title: Scale instruments, account stages, and correlated exposure
acceptance: Additional Topstep-supported instruments are onboarded with evidence.
Additional account products and stages are supported with reconciled policy.
Portfolio-level correlated exposure evidence is recorded.
Topstep-native account or copy capabilities are used only when officially supported and reconciled.

items.title: Extract venue-neutral contracts after Topstep proof
acceptance: Reusable venue-neutral contracts are extracted only after the Topstep implementation is proven.
No Apex or NinjaTrader assumptions leak into the Topstep core during extraction.
